rationale: Kevin is building AI-driven quality assurance at Zof with a core conviction that AI should amplify team capabilities rather than replace them, while Hercules leads AI tooling at Brex with deep expertise in agentic systems and human-AI collaboration in software engineering. Both share a focus on AI-human collaboration across different layers of the engineering stack—Kevin on QA automation and Hercules on developer productivity agents—and could exchange perspectives on scaling AI adoption while maintaining technical excellence and organizational alignment.
intro_message: Kevin Kissi, meet Hercules Giaretta Gimenes — you're both building human-amplifying AI systems in software engineering (QA testing vs. agentic developer tools) and share the conviction that AI should enhance rather than replace engineering teams.
